## Assessment as Transaction

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
Learner ->> Instructor: Here is my paper!
Instructor -->> Learner: Here is your grade!
Learner ->> Instructor: Here is another paper.
Instructor -->> Learner: Here is another grade.
Instructor -->> Learner: Here is your final grade.
Instructor -->> Institution: Here is their final grade.
Institution ->> Learner: Here are your credits.
```
